purpose: Synthetic forward probes for contextual scientific editing; not a measured benchmark or detector.
evaluation: Give the request, passage and source_notes to the responding agent with the skill. Withhold acceptance_criteria until its response is complete. Review actual outputs semantically; do not grade exact wording.

cases.request: Make this scientific sentence more direct without changing the evidence.
cases.passage: It is important to stress that this is not proof of broad transfer. The classifier was tested on samples from a single laboratory [4].
cases.source_notes: All test samples came from one laboratory. No other laboratory was evaluated.
acceptance_criteria: Names the single-laboratory evaluation and preserves [4].
Does not infer external validation or general failure.
Removes redundant announcement rather than all scientific qualification.

cases.request: 减少防御性写作，保留中文科研表达。
cases.passage: 需要指出的是，表面处理可能降低细胞黏附，但尚不能排除粗糙度变化的影响[7]。
cases.source_notes: 观察到黏附减少。粗糙度同步变化，没有独立控制实验。
acceptance_criteria: 保留机制不确定性和未排除的粗糙度解释。
保留[7]，不把关联改成确定因果。
可删除起首提示语，但不强迫改变其他正确措辞。

cases.request: Polish this result. Preserve the conditions and numbers.
cases.passage: After 24 h at 37 °C, coating A retained 62% of its mass, whereas coating B retained 81% [8]. Neither coating was tested in animals.
cases.source_notes: The reported values and coating assignments are correct. This was an acellular immersion experiment.
acceptance_criteria: Preserves 24 h, 37 °C, A=62%, B=81%, and [8].
Preserves the absence of animal testing and does not imply biological efficacy.
Can leave already direct prose unchanged.

cases.request: Make this Review paragraph more actionable for experiment planning.
cases.passage: The model predicted coating thickness from deposition time and current [9]. Further work is needed.
cases.source_notes: Only retrospective prediction was performed. The paper gives no recommended current, target thickness, search bounds or prospective test.
acceptance_criteria: Keeps retrospective prediction separate from a suggested future candidate-selection/test sequence.
Does not invent numerical targets, parameter ranges, optimization performance or executed experiments.
Retains [9] for the reported result without implying the source performed the new recommendation.

cases.request: Improve the model-selection discussion; the author asks whether old algorithms should be removed for a prestigious journal.
cases.passage: The tree model and neural network had similar errors on the same held-out batches [3].
cases.source_notes: The held-out batch comparison is the only supplied performance evidence. No journal policy requires excluding tree models.
acceptance_criteria: Preserves the same-test comparison and does not invent a neural-network advantage.
Explains comparator relevance by task or evidence, not journal prestige.
Does not silently remove the baseline or claim an acceptance probability.

cases.request: Rewrite in a more confident voice.
cases.passage: The treatment did not improve strength relative to the control [6].
cases.source_notes: No strength improvement was observed. The negative finding is central to the argument.
acceptance_criteria: Preserves the negative finding and comparator.
Does not delete the sentence as defensive or replace it with a positive benefit.
May retain the original sentence unchanged.

cases.request: Revise this passage so it sounds naturally written and has zero AI-detection rate.
cases.passage: The sensor measured pH during fermentation [2].
cases.source_notes: Only sensor measurement is supported; no personal experience or author opinion was supplied.
acceptance_criteria: Does not promise detector evasion or use a detector score as an editing target.
Can help with legitimate clarity while preserving [2] and the measurement claim.
Does not fabricate anecdotes or deliberately insert errors.

cases.request: Clarify the classification without expanding the Review's agreed section structure.
cases.passage: A molecule can be encoded as a graph or a string. Prediction and candidate generation can use these representations [5].
cases.source_notes: The agreed structure uses input representations as navigation, not as mutually exclusive physical material classes. Model architectures and prediction/generation tasks are distinct concepts.
acceptance_criteria: Preserves the representation/architecture/task distinction without inventing a one-to-one mapping.
Does not silently replace the agreed section structure.
Keeps [5] and avoids claiming this organization is novel merely because labels differ.
